processes.realtime_congestion_allocation_and_recon: Real-time desk reports congestion relief and reconciles Enpower to CAPS variances, inc sheets and EPE reconciliation sheets, notifying settlement/scheduling staff and allocating charges to the right desk.
processes.realtime_deal_entry_procedure_guidance: Desk manager issues deal-entry, scheduling and cut-handling procedures (Enpower books, timezone, strips, tag changes, deal sheets) that staff must follow and later fix or re-key against.
processes.caiso_market_notice_distribution: Forwarding and relaying CAISO market notices, price-cap updates and call-ins to the real-time trading staff so they can act on them.
processes.realtime_lending_position_request: Real-time desk tells the lending/scheduling analyst which pieces of position are short so they can be sourced for the next day.
